name: contract-history-retention
goal: Rebuild complete source history without retaining full revision source state or corrupting shared-tree catalog measurement provenance

evidence: Full 2873-revision reconstruction retained about 6 GB after only 42 revisions. A strengthened existing archive case additionally checks that two commits sharing a tree retain their own catalog measurement revision.

The existing archive case covered only two different trees and verified JSON/media, not the SQLite catalog measurement provenance. Extend that same case with an unchanged-tree commit and exact selected-revision assertions; keep one case.
The existing single archive case fails the selected-commit catalog provenance assertion at the committed unchanged-tree fixture. Harness retains the failed command, source/test corpus and assertion.

Working repair now writes each full immutable snapshot before retaining compact summaries, streams persisted snapshots to SQLite, interns repeated ledger entries, and bounds source/registry/media caches. The same existing archive assertion passes with unchanged tests.

The paired immutable Harness record reruns the frozen existing archive case against the repair, with the original test corpus, assertion, command and runtime unchanged; selected-commit JSON, media and SQLite catalog provenance now pass.
